acceptance_tests: Measure raw vector forces and moments with S2kg, orientations0–90, sharp bump and sanding drag before hardware tare; verify calibration and complex-loading limits.
Assembled combined-force/moment loading and unloading calibration at temperatures from cold start through continuous-coil heat; retain independent check loads.
Test residual bias/gain/crosstalk in native qualification separately from sample RMS noise; proposed .05–.1N residual not a manufacturer guarantee.
Measure force/accelerometer/position transfer functions, mechanical modes, sample skew, filter group delay and computation delay with mounted tool.
Measure reconstructed force-axis RMS noise at actual bandwidth with motor PWM, cables and tool vibration active; verify no ADC saturation.
S–A position calibration across25mm, orientation and temperature, with motor active; measure bracket strain and B–S compliance, handle homing/encoder alarm/lost counts.
Validate true normal force using independent workpiece reference load cell; manufacturer resolution alone cannot qualify ±.5N.
recommendation: Prototype Mini27 Titanium SI80-4 class six-axis analog force acquisition with synchronized S acceleration and protected TONiC/RELM S–A encoder; conditional on measured raw loading, residual calibration and assembled dynamics.
